mapper.select: SELECT F.FRIEND_SEQ AS FRIEND_MEMBER_SEQ, F.FRIEND_SEQ AS MEMBER_SEQ, 'ACCEPTED' AS FRIEND_STATUS, M.LOGIN_ID AS LOGIN_ID, (SELECT MAX(MP.NICKNAME) FROM MEMBER_PROFILE MP WHERE MP.MEMBER_SEQ = M.MEMBER_SEQ) AS NICKNAME, (SELECT PI.FILE_URL FROM PROFILE_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.MEMBER_SEQ = M.MEMBER_SEQ AND PI.PROFILE_IMAGE_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(PI2.PROFILE_IMAGE_SEQ) FROM PROFILE_IMAGE PI2 WHERE PI2.MEMBER_SEQ = M.MEMBER_SEQ)) AS PROFILE_IMAGE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN MEMBER_SEQ = #{value} THEN FRIEND_MEMBER_SEQ ELSE MEMBER_SEQ END AS FRIEND_SEQ FROM MEMBER_FRIEND WHERE (MEMBER_SEQ = #{value} OR FRIEND_MEMBER_SEQ = #{value}) AND FRIEND_STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' ) F JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_SEQ = F.FRIEND_SEQ WHERE M.MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY NICKNAME

SELECT F.FRIEND_SEQ AS FRIEND_MEMBER_SEQ, F.FRIEND_SEQ AS MEMBER_SEQ, 'ACCEPTED' AS FRIEND_STATUS, M.LOGIN_ID AS LOGIN_ID, (SELECT MAX(MP.NICKNAME) FROM MEMBER_PROFILE MP WHERE MP.MEMBER_SEQ = M.MEMBER_SEQ) AS NICKNAME, (SELECT PI.FILE_URL FROM PROFILE_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.MEMBER_SEQ = M.MEMBER_SEQ AND PI.PROFILE_IMAGE_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(PI2.PROFILE_IMAGE_SEQ) FROM PROFILE_IMAGE PI2 WHERE PI2.MEMBER_SEQ = M.MEMBER_SEQ)) AS PROFILE_IMAGE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} THEN FRIEND_MEMBER_SEQ ELSE MEMBER_SEQ END AS FRIEND_SEQ FROM MEMBER_FRIEND WHERE (MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} OR FRIEND_MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq}) AND FRIEND_STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' ) F JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_SEQ = F.FRIEND_SEQ WHERE M.MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.MEMBER_SEQ != #{memberSeq} AND LOWER((SELECT MAX(MP.NICKNAME) FROM MEMBER_PROFILE MP WHERE MP.MEMBER_SEQ = M.MEMBER_SEQ)) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' ORDER BY NICKNAME

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_FRIEND WHERE FRIEND_STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND ((MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} AND FRIEND_MEMBER_SEQ = #{friendSeq}) OR (MEMBER_SEQ = #{friendSeq} AND FRIEND_MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq}))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_FRIEND WHERE (MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} AND FRIEND_MEMBER_SEQ = #{friendSeq}) OR (MEMBER_SEQ = #{friendSeq} AND FRIEND_MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq})

SELECT MF.MEMBER_FRIEND_SEQ, MF.MEMBER_SEQ, MF.FRIEND_MEMBER_SEQ, MF.FRIEND_STATUS, MF.MEMBER_SEQ AS REQUESTER_MEMBER_SEQ, MF.FRIEND_MEMBER_SEQ AS REQUESTED_MEMBER_SEQ, M.LOGIN_ID AS LOGIN_ID, NVL((SELECT MAX(MP.NICKNAME) FROM MEMBER_PROFILE MP WHERE MP.MEMBER_SEQ = M.MEMBER_SEQ), M.NICKNAME) AS NICKNAME, (SELECT PI.FILE_URL FROM PROFILE_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.MEMBER_SEQ = M.MEMBER_SEQ AND PI.PROFILE_IMAGE_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(PI2.PROFILE_IMAGE_SEQ) FROM PROFILE_IMAGE PI2 WHERE PI2.MEMBER_SEQ = M.MEMBER_SEQ)) AS PROFILE_IMAGE FROM MEMBER_FRIEND MF JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_SEQ = MF.MEMBER_SEQ WHERE MF.FRIEND_MEMBER_SEQ = #{value} AND MF.FRIEND_STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY MF.MEMBER_FRIEND_SEQ DESC
